# BridgeEA / TestEA export samples (synthetic, sanitized)

Small **synthetic** bundles for automated governance tests. These are **sanitized** placeholders aligned with the V2-12 export-sample validators — **not real broker or account data**.

## Governance

- **No large exports**: committed files are intentionally tiny.
- **Real MT5 exports must stay outside the repo** (use gitignored staging or keep exports local-only).
- **Export-only posture**: BridgeEA/TestEA in this project are **export-only**; these samples **do not** enable **execution** or live trading toward a real account.

Synthetic samples **do not** prove profitability.
